src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2020_us_cd116_500k
cd.vint: The Census Bureau's lines of the 116th Congress's districts (its file says session 116). The Bureau published no file of the 117th Congress's districts, the Congress the 2020 election chose.
rec: Chapter 177 of the Acts of 2011 (H.3798, 'An Act establishing congressional districts', approved Nov. 21, 2011); 9 districts
Massachusetts General Court, Acts of 2011 Chapter 177 (approved November 21, 2011)
Census cb_2020 cd116 file: 9 districts. First used in the 2012 elections.

src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2020_us_sldu_500k
sldu.vint: The Census Bureau's 2020 file of legislative districts, the lines it records for the 2018 legislative session year. The Bureau published no file of the lines in use for 2020. Where a state's lines changed in between, the check below or the plan cited stops the map.
rec: Chapter 152 of the Acts of 2011 (S.2045, 'An Act establishing executive councillor and senatorial districts', signed Nov. 3, 2011); 40 districts
Massachusetts General Court, Bill S.2045 (187th): signed Nov. 3, 2011, Chapter 152 of the Acts of 2011

Census cb_2020 sldu file: LSY 2018, 40 districts. District ids and names differ between the 2020 and later Census files: the cb_2020 sldu file numbers districts in the Census's older scheme (001 to 040, 'First Suffolk' first) and names them differently from the cb_2022 and cb_2024 files (D01 to D40, 'Berkshire-Hampden-Franklin-Hampshire' first); match by the district's printed name or by the plan's own order, never by id across years.

src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2020_us_sldl_500k
sldl.vint: The Census Bureau's 2020 file of legislative districts, the lines it records for the 2018 legislative session year. The Bureau published no file of the lines in use for 2020. Where a state's lines changed in between, the check below or the plan cited stops the map.
rec: Chapter 153 of the Acts of 2011 (H.3770, 'An Act relative to establishing representative districts in the General Court', signed Nov. 3, 2011); 160 districts
Massachusetts General Court, Bill H.3770 (187th): signed Nov. 3, 2011, Chapter 153 of the Acts of 2011

Census cb_2020 sldl file: LSY 2018, 160 districts. District ids and names differ between the 2020 and later Census files: the cb_2020 sldl file numbers districts in the Census's older scheme (060 to 219, '1st Barnstable' = 060) and names them differently from the cb_2022 and cb_2024 files (001 to 160, '1st Barnstable' = 001); match by the district's printed name or by the plan's own order, never by id across years.
